chapter: Big band, Chicago players, recordings and gospel
title: The Evolution of Jazz school program with Muddy Waters
summary: After five years in schools he created an Evolution of Jazz show with a big band, Muddy Waters on blues and a gospel group.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: But the one that I was really proud of -- we stayed on that five years. Then they took us into the high schools then. The African thing was done mostly for the elementary schools to acquaint the kids with their heritage and things like this. Then we had the big band things into the jazz -- I mean, into the -- then I did what I called the evolution of jazz.

Yeah, so we had the big band, and then for the blues segment, we had Muddy Waters. He would do the blues segment, and then for the gospel segment of it, we had a group -- now they've changed over because a lot of the gospel groups have changed over to rock and roll. We had a group --
called them. Now they call them the Emotions, now.
